description: Platform + technical SEO foundation: scheduled publishing (D1), Post model pillars/author/cta (D2), seoTitle helper and all title/description/heading/breadcrumb fixes (D4), robots AI-bot rules, Search Console/Bing verification meta, IndexNow route + owner script, BlogPosting author/dates + visible Last updated + AuthorBox + per-pillar end CTA + PillarNav, crawler extension for article link counts. Plan items 1, 2, 3, 4 and the audit.mjs part of item 13 in .agents/tasks/seo-plan-impl.md. Everything later depends on this FEAT.
steps: Read the Next 16 docs listed in plan section 0 (ISR, caching-without-cache-components, dynamicParams, sitemap, robots, generate-metadata verification, metadata-and-og-images).

Plan item 1: create src/content/insights/schedule.ts (todayIST with Asia/Kolkata + CONTENT_NOW override, isPublished); extend src/content/insights/types.ts with pillar/pillarHub/author/cta; set pillar on all 26 existing posts using the D2 mapping (pillarHub on app-development-cost-india, ai-agents-for-business-operations, software-developer-career-chandigarh-tricity); rewrite src/content/insights/index.ts to export call-time functions getPublishedPosts/getPost/relatedPosts/postsByPillar/isPostSlugPublished; create src/components/insights/PostLink.tsx and PillarNav.tsx; switch every consumer listed in D1; add `export const revalidate = 3600` to the D1 route list and `dynamicParams = true` on insights/[slug] page + opengraph-image; LandingView drops related links to unpublished posts.

Plan item 2: add seoTitle() in src/components/pages/seo.ts and use it in pageMetadata, landingMetadata (landing-seo.ts) and insights generateMetadata; shorten every metaTitle so the final <title> is <= 60 chars; rewrite siteConfig.description to 150-160 chars leading with regulated software (no new claims); shorten the /insights description to <= 160; change 'Choose a track' in src/components/home/Academy.tsx to an h2; convert /insights JSON-LD to @graph with breadcrumbJsonLd('Insights','/insights').

Plan item 3: robots.ts rules array (* allow + explicit GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot allow '/'); layout.tsx metadata.verification from GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION / BING_SITE_VERIFICATION (msvalidate.01) only when set; src/app/indexnow.txt/route.ts (404 when INDEXNOW_KEY unset); scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs (zero-dep, owner-run, do NOT execute); document all env vars from D3 in .env.local.example.

Plan item 4: src/content/authors.ts (empty AUTHORS, FOUNDER = null, getAuthor) + src/components/insights/AuthorBox.tsx; insights/[slug]/page.tsx byline 'Published X · Last updated Y', Person schema only for a real author else Organization, image as ImageObject, end CTA to the per-pillar service (D2) plus /#contact, render PillarNav.

Item 13 (crawler part): extend .kiro/skills/seo-audit/scripts/audit.mjs (keep zero-dependency) to WARN when an /insights/<slug> page has < 3 internal links inside <article> body and when no 'Last updated' <time> is present.
Run the FEAT verification, record route-table ISR evidence, crawler warning counts before/after and any gotchas in this file's findings.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint and npm run build pass; build route table marks home, /insights, /insights/[slug], sitemap.xml, llms.txt and landing routes as revalidating every 1h

A temporary post dated 2026-12-31 (removed afterwards) returns 404 on next start -p 3100 and is absent from /insights, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, the home teaser and related links; with CONTENT_NOW=2026-12-31 it renders
Crawler: 0 errors, 0 'title too long' and 0 'description long' warnings, no /academy heading-skip info, BreadcrumbList on every inner page
robots.txt lists all 7 AI/search bots with Allow: /; no verification meta and /indexnow.txt 404 when env unset; meta tags and key file appear in a test build with env set
Every post shows 'Last updated' with a <time>, an end CTA to a service page and pillar links; no AuthorBox rendered while AUTHORS is empty; existing post published dates unchanged
verification: npx next start -p 3100 (background) then node .kiro/skills/seo-audit/scripts/audit.mjs http://localhost:3100 --out .agents/seo-audit-2026-10-04.md
$env:CONTENT_NOW="2026-12-31"; npm run build; Remove-Item Env:CONTENT_NOW (scheduled-post check), then rebuild normally

for_later_feats: Content API (src/content/insights/index.ts): POSTS is private. Use getPublishedPosts(today?), getPost(slug) (live only), isPostSlugPublished(slug), relatedPosts(post), postsByPillar(), pillarHub(pillar), postCta(post), PILLARS (name + default CTA per pillar), todayIST(). formatDate unchanged.

Post type now REQUIRES `pillar`; optional pillarHub (true), author (id), cta {href,label}. New posts: register in index.ts; regulated hub gxp-software-validation-guide (FEAT-004) must set pillarHub: true — until it is live, regulated posts show 'More on regulated software' list without a 'Part of' line.

In post bodies link to other posts with <PostLink slug="...">text</PostLink> from @/components/insights/PostLink (plain text until target is live). Landing `related` hrefs to /insights/<slug> are filtered automatically by LandingView.

CTA overrides set on existing posts: website-development-cost-small-business-india, custom-software-vs-saas, how-to-choose-software-development-company-india -> /services/web-platforms; flutter-developer-hiring-models -> /hire-flutter-developers-india (more relevant than the D2 default /services/mobile-apps; small deviation, existing page).

seoTitle(metaTitle) in src/components/pages/seo.ts (MAX_TITLE=60): brand suffix only if the result fits in 60, else metaTitle alone. pageMetadata uses it, so landingMetadata and every inner page inherit it. New metaTitles must be <= 60 chars.

New route src/app/industries/[slug]/page.tsx (FEAT-002/009 item) must add `export const revalidate = 3600` (plus dynamicParams=false) like services/[slug]; any hub/tool/resource page that renders PostLink also needs revalidate = 3600.

Authors: src/content/authors.ts exports Author type, AUTHORS (empty), FOUNDER (null, typed via `as` cast), getAuthor(id), isFounder(author). Person schema url -> /about/founder only for the founder (page comes in FEAT-005).

Crawler: audit.mjs now WARNs per /insights/<slug> for < 3 internal links in the first <article> after stripping <nav> and <aside> (breadcrumb, TOC, PillarNav, AuthorBox, end CTA don't count) and for missing 'Last updated' <time dateTime>. Report table has a 'Body links' column. The 7 current WARNs are the work list for item 12 (FEAT-006).

Env vars documented in .env.local.example: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_CALENDLY_URL, GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION, BING_SITE_VERIFICATION, INDEXNOW_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_LEAD_FORM_ENDPOINT, CONTENT_NOW (QA only). Verification + IndexNow key are read at BUILD time (static), so the owner must rebuild/redeploy after setting them.

QA recipe that worked: for CONTENT_NOW checks set it for both build AND `next start` (ISR re-renders use the server's env). Stop the server with Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3100 -State Listen | % { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }.
gotchas: An editor/IDE formatter in this workspace reformats files on save (Prettier-style line wrapping). Every file edited in this FEAT (all 26 posts, audit.mjs, opengraph-image.tsx, LandingView.tsx…) shows large whitespace/wrapping diffs; word-level diff confirms only the intended tokens changed (e.g. csv-vs-csa: +pillar line, rest is re-wrapping). After an edit, re-read before a second str_replace on the same file because line breaks change.
grep_search tool needs includePattern prefixed with 'brightinfonet-web/' (workspace root is the parent folder).
React SSR emits 'Last updated<!-- --> <time ...>' (comment between text and element) — regexes must allow it.
robots.ts with userAgent array prints one 'User-Agent:' line per bot followed by a single shared 'Allow: /' (valid grouping).

Pre-existing uncommitted owner changes (globals.css, several *.module.css, Hero.tsx, Services.tsx, InsightsTeaser.tsx) were left untouched apart from InsightsTeaser's POSTS -> getPublishedPosts() swap.
